items.t: Rivian Is Down 41% This Year. Can RIVN Stock Get Back to $20 in 2027?
items.sum: Rivian posted record deliveries and a hit new R2, yet investors keep heading for the exits while losses pile up. Three pressure points will decide whether the factory-floor momentum ever reaches the share price.

items.t: The EV Bubble Burst After Rivian’s IPO. Could Anthropic Trigger a Similar Collapse in AI Stocks?
items.sum: AI stocks have fallen after Anthropic's IPO, which reminds one of the EV bubble bursting following Rivian's 2021 IPO.

items.t: Tesla Slides 6% as EU Delays Vote on Its Self-Driving Software; Rivian and Lucid Drop 4%
items.sum: Tesla calls Full Self-Driving the key driver of demand, yet Europe keeps stalling on a vote. With France and Sweden raising safety flags and rivals Rivian and Lucid dragged along, one December date could decide what comes next.

items.t: Is Rivian Stock Stronger Than It Looks?
items.sum: Today's big story: Anthropic Below Its IPO Price: Do Giants Come Back.

items.t: Rivian Recalls 1,619 Vehicles Whose Tire Placard Or Certification Label May Misstate Wheel, Tire And Spare Configuration, Raising Crash Risk
Lucid Rises 4% as Driverless Robotaxi Testing With Nuro and Uber Begins; Tesla Falls 2% Amid SpaceX Merger Talks, Rivian Edges Higher
items.sum: Lucid is down roughly three quarters this year, yet its robotaxi gamble just hit public roads without safety drivers. Can a vehicle supplier with no software of its own challenge Tesla while Musk eyes a mega-merger?
